names: area: rate gmo no pokemon delay
area: rate gmo no cell delay

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(Datetime,$__interval) AS "time",
  case when count(controller_worker)<3 then sum(numrep) else count(controller_worker) end as 'area: workers',
  sum(mons_seen) AS 'area: Mons scanned',
  sum(mons_enc) AS 'area: Mons encountered',
--  100*sum(mons_enc)/sum(mons_seen) AS 'area: %IV',
  sum(loc_time)/sum(loc_success) AS "area: Location handling time",
  sum(loc_count) AS "area: Locations handled",
  100*sum(loc_success)/sum(loc_count) AS "area: Location success rate",
--  100*sum(numRep)/(sum(rpl)/5) AS "area: % raw data received",
--  sum(rpl)*60 - sum(loc_time) AS "area: lost scanning time",
--  sum(stops) as "#Stops spun",
--  sum(quests) as "#Quests scanned"
  sum(distance) as "area: distance",
  sum(gmos) as "area: total GMOs",
  sum(retries) as "area: retries",
  sum(timeElapsed)/sum(loc_count) as "area: proto time",
  sum(locationDelay)/sum(loc_count) as "area: location delay",
  sum(locationDelay)/(sum(locationDelay)+sum(timeElapsed)) as "area: rate location delay",
  (0.25*(sum(retries)-sum(gmoNoCell)))/(sum(locationDelay)+sum(timeElapsed)) as "area: rate gmo no pokemon delay",
  (0.5*sum(gmoNoCell))/(sum(locationDelay)+sum(timeElapsed)) as "area: rate gmo no cell delay",
  (sum(timeElapsed)-(0.5*sum(gmoNoCell))-(0.25*(sum(retries)-sum(gmoNoCell))))/(sum(locationDelay)+sum(timeElapsed)) as "area: real proto time",
  sum(gmoGivingUp) as "area: GMO giving up",
  (sum(gmo0fail)-sum(gmo1fail))/sum(gmo0fail) as 'GMO success after retry #1',
  (sum(gmo1fail)-sum(gmo2fail))/sum(gmo0fail) as '#2',
  (sum(gmo2fail)-sum(gmo3fail))/sum(gmo0fail) as '#3',
  (sum(gmo3fail)-sum(gmo4fail))/sum(gmo0fail) as '#4',
  (sum(gmo4fail)-sum(gmo5fail))/sum(gmo0fail) as '#5',
  (sum(gmo5fail)-sum(gmo6fail))/sum(gmo0fail) as '#6',
  (sum(gmo6fail)-sum(gmo7fail))/sum(gmo0fail) as '#7',
  (sum(gmo7fail)-sum(gmo8fail))/sum(gmo0fail) as '#8',
  100*sum(gmoInitialSuccess)/sum(loc_count) as 'area: gmo initial success rate',
  100*sum(gmoGivingUp)/sum(loc_count) as 'area: gmo failure rate'
FROM stats_worker
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(Datetime) and
  RPL='$RPL' and
  controller_worker in ($drago_worker) and
  mode in ($mode) and
  LEFT(controller_worker, LENGTH(controller_worker) - LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(controller_worker, '_', -1)) - 1) in ($Area) 
GROUP BY 1  
ORDER BY $__timeGroup(Datetime,$__interval)
